reference.limits: 60 calls per minute → 429 {key: throttled}. - Self-serve - test_order flag for non-billed tests

fields.name: api_key
fields.help: Dreamship API key from Settings (https://dreamship.com/app/settings), sent as `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>`.

config_fields.name: test_order
config_fields.help: Set to true to send `test_order: true` on create_order (test orders are not billed or fulfilled); left out of the body when unset, so orders are real.

me.note: Dreamship has no account endpoint; the probe lists the connected shops ({paging{count, next, previous}, data[{id, key, name, channel, shop_url, status}]}). Rate limit 60 calls/minute.

list_products.note: GET /items/ lists Dreamship's blank catalogue items ({paging{count, next, previous}, data[{id, name, description, colors, sizes, options, print_areas, ship_zones, starting_basic_cost, release_status}]}); `query` and `category` are not accepted here (items of one category come from GET /categories/{id}/items/, not mapped). Costs are decimal strings (starting_basic_cost), so `price` is left empty.

get_product.note: GET /items/{id}/: the item with item_variants[{id, name, color, size, cost, basic_cost, availability}], print_areas[{key, w, h, dpi}] and ship_zones[{countries, ship_zone_methods[{method, cost, delivery_days_min, delivery_days_max}]}] in `raw`. Order line_items use item_variant ids and print_area keys from here.

create_order.note: POST /orders/ places a real, billed order unless the test_order setting is true. `shipping_address` is Dreamship's address {first_name, last_name, street1, street2, city, state, zip, country (ISO-2), phone, force_verified_delivery}; `items` are line_items [{item_variant | product_variant, quantity, print_areas[{key, url}]}]; `shipping_option` is shipping_method (economy, express, ground, two_day, ...). Costs are decimal strings (total_cost).

get_order.note: GET /orders/{id}/: {id, status (draft, submitted, accepted, rejected, partially_fulfilled, fulfilled, cancelled), payment_status, total_cost (decimal string), created_at, line_items, fulfillments[{trackings[{carrier, status, tracking_number, tracking_url}]}]}; `tracking_number` is the first fulfillment's first tracking.

not_offered.quote_shipping: GET /items/{item_id}/ship-zones/ lists zones ({countries, group, ship_zone_methods[{method, delivery_days_min, delivery_days_max}]}) without prices and takes no country or quantity; costs sit in ship_zones of GET /items/{id}/ (see get_product `raw`), so there is no quote endpoint for the product_id/country/quantity shape.
not_offered.track: No tracking-events endpoint; fulfillments[].trackings[{carrier, status, tracking_number, tracking_url}] are part of GET /orders/{id}/ (see get_order).

evidence: host api.dreamship.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Google Trust Services)
probe: 5/5 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 5/5 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
